item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 12/Sep/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak and the weather will be very hot over the coast of southern China tomorrow. High temperatures will also trigger showers. Upper-air disturbances will bring a few showers to Guangdong over the weekend. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect southern China early to midweek next week. Meanwhile, a broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the seas near Luzon. An area of low pressure may also form over the trough of low pressure. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Bebinca will move across the western North Pacific towards the Ryukyu Islands and intensify gradually in the next couple of days. It will then edge closer to the vicinity of eastern China.
